name: Char's Ennui
source:
A doujin Gundam visual novel set set in a CCA AU where the war is averted in exchange for Amuro's permanent residence in Char's custody.

[From [url=https://x.com/esshemasha/status/2009566324582936667]X[/url]]
translation:
一部以CCA AU为背景的同人高达视觉小说，在那里，阿姆罗在夏亚的监护下永久居住，从而避免了战争。

[来自[url=https://x.com/esshemasha/status/2009566324582936667]X[/url]]
